description: Published 2022 Lövsta annual electricity totals and 499 kWe rating; uniform annual-average assumed schedule valued at separate 2020 SE3 spot prices, NOT actual 2020 plant output/revenue
parameter_status: mixed: documented annual energy and nameplate, assumed fuel efficiency and constant output
efficiency_note: 40% electrical efficiency is an assumption, NOT calibrated to plant measured gas input. Thermal fraction chosen algebraically to reproduce reported 2022 heat:electric annual production ratio, not measured efficiency.
heat_note: 2022 reported annual heat production 2939.5 MWh; matched by assumed thermal coefficient on uniform annual-average power, NOT proof of heat demand fulfilment
price_source: Svenska kraftnat historical SE3 day-ahead area price dataset CC BY 4.0
raw_price_rights: CC-BY-4.0 per Svenska kraftnat resource metadata (https://data.svk.se/sv/dataset/market_data_day_ahead_area_prices/resource/cf392ef3-7345-4e98-970e-83088c185570); attribute author and link license
plant_reference: Alexander Åberg (2024), SLU thesis section 5.4.1 Table 1, data reported from Lövsta 2022, https://stud.epsilon.slu.se/20493/1/aberg-a-20240904.pdf
